en.title: Free-trial guard + unused subscription finder
en.summary: Run a “try it, don’t pay for it” flow: start a free trial, then cancel or remind before billing—and pair it with unused-subscription cleanup. Bots confirm before changing anything.
en.whyItWorks: Trials convert when reminders fail. Separating watch/remind from cancel—and requiring confirmation—cuts accidental charges without giving the bot unchecked control.
workflowSteps: Create a trial-guard bot with fields: service name, trial end date, cancel URL/path, and remind-me-before window.
When you start a trial, log it with the bot immediately.
Schedule a routine before the bill date to remind or prepare cancellation steps.
Pair a second prompt to list unused subscriptions you might cancel.
Require explicit confirmation before the bot marks anything canceled or drafts a cancel action.
en.promptTemplate:
You manage free trials and unused subscriptions.

Mode A — Trial guard:
When I log a trial, store: service, start date, end/bill date, cancel path, remind N days before.
On schedule, remind me and outline cancel steps. Never cancel without my yes.

Mode B — Unused subscriptions:
Help me list plans I may not use. For each, ask before any cancel draft.

Always confirm before changing anything.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use a before-renewal routine for reminders. Optional Gmail/bot inbox for trial confirmations and receipts. Every cancel path is confirm-before-change.
acceptanceChecklist: Logging a trial stores the service, start date, end or bill date, cancel path, and the remind-before window you set.
The before-renewal routine reminds you and outlines the cancel steps, and it does not cancel unless you say yes.
The unused-subscription pass lists plans you may not be using and asks before it drafts a cancellation.
The bot asks you to confirm before it changes anything.

zh.title: 免费试用守卫 + 闲置订阅清理
zh.summary: 跑一套「先试用、别白付钱」：开通免费试用后，在扣费前取消或提醒；再搭配闲置订阅清理。Bot 改动前必须确认。
zh.whyItWorks: 试用常因忘记提醒而扣费。把盯梢/提醒与取消分开，并强制确认，既能少误扣，又不把控制权裸交给 Bot。
workflowSteps: 创建试用守卫 Bot，字段含：服务名、试用结束日、取消路径、提前提醒窗口。
每次开通试用立刻登记到 Bot。
在账单日前安排例行，提醒或准备取消步骤。
再用第二套提示列出可能闲置、可取消的订阅。
Bot 标记取消或起草取消动作前，必须得到你的明确确认。
zh.promptTemplate:
你负责管理免费试用与闲置订阅。

模式 A — 试用守卫：
我登记试用时，记录：服务、开始日、结束/扣费日、取消路径、提前 N 天提醒。
到期前按日程提醒并列出取消步骤。未经我说「可以」不得取消。

模式 B — 闲置订阅：
帮我列出可能不用的方案。每一项在起草取消前都要询问。

任何变更前必须确认。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用续费前例行做提醒。可选 Gmail/Bot 收件箱承接试用确认与收据。所有取消路径均为确认后执行。
acceptanceChecklist: 登记一次试用后，会记下服务、开始日、结束或扣费日、取消路径，以及你设定的提前提醒窗口。
续费前的例行会提醒你并列出取消步骤，未经你说可以就不会取消。
闲置订阅这一步会列出你可能没在用的方案，并在起草取消前询问。
Bot 在改动任何内容之前都会先请你确认。

source.excerpt: Grok Bot workflow: the "Try it, don't pay for it" template starts a free trial for you, then cancels it or reminds you before it bills. Pair it with "Find unused subscriptions" to cancel plans you pick. Bots confirm before changing anything. #GrokBot
